component.name: Play it Slowly
component.summary: Play music slower or at another pitch to practise and transcribe

description.p: Play it Slowly plays an audio file at a different speed without changing its pitch, or at a different pitch without changing its speed. It helps musicians learn and transcribe music.

ul.li: Speed, pitch in semitones and fine pitch in cents
Loop a section, with a waveform and buttons to nudge the loop points
Balance, left/right and mid/side modes to bring out or remove vocals and instruments
A count-in before playing, keyboard and number pad shortcuts
Download the audio of a YouTube video to practise with
Save the result as WAV, MP3, Ogg Vorbis or FLAC

screenshot.caption: A song slowed down, with a loop section on the waveform

description.p: The first release of the maintained fork:

ul.li: Runs on current systems with GTK 3, Python 3.14 and GStreamer 1.28
A waveform display with draggable loop markers
Balance modes, a count-in, a loop switch, a limiter and new keyboard shortcuts
YouTube audio download, drag and drop, and MP3, Ogg and FLAC export
Fixed looping at the end of a track, rewinding by seconds and the end position after loading

description.p: This is a bug fix release:

ul.li: Updated to Python3, GTK3 and GStreamer 1.0
Fixed a bug where the file chooser would not show the currently selected file
